dedupe_keys.name: real world multi year hourly district heating demand data for denmark three metered areas

description: This data set gives hourly heat consumption from 4,910 smart meters in a Danish district heating system, aggregated over three district metered areas, from 1 January 2016 to 31 December 2019 with no missing timestamps. It was published on Zenodo in October 2025 by Adithya Ramachandran, Siming Bayer, Andreas Maier and Satyaki Chatterjee, and accompanies their 2026 Energy and AI paper on deep learning heat demand forecasting with time-frequency representations. Hourly consumption in kWh was derived from cumulative meter readings by differencing and summed per area; for each area the files give aggregated consumption, consumption per active meter and the number of contributing meters at each hour. Coverage is three metered areas of one Danish system whose town is not named. Files are CSV, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: data are aggregated, and building characteristics are not included. Simulation uses are heat demand forecasting, production scheduling and cold spell peak studies. Related records: data-denmark-3021-smart-heat-meters gives building-level Danish heat meter data.
